items.title: Quantum computers threaten exposed private keys rather than blockchains, Europol warns
items.summary: EU law enforcement agencies urged developers, exchanges, and users to initiate phased post-quantum migrations immediately to prevent future unauthorized fund transfers.

items.title: Ether is about to lose a steady buyer as Tom Lee says Bitmine will stop token purchases
items.summary: Tom Lee said Bitmine will be “done stacking” once it owns 5% of ETH, setting an end date to an accumulation streak that began in mid-2025 and made the company the world's largest Ethereum treasury.
